record.official_identifier: California Senate Bill 243 (2025-2026 Regular Session); Chapter 677, Statutes of 2025

verification.note: Stored the Governor's release (gov.ca.gov, 13 Oct 2025), which confirms the signing and the provisions; the author's Senate press release (sd18.senate.ca.gov), which confirms the signing date, the author and that the bill becomes law on 1 January 2026; and the Assembly's 2025 legislative bill summary (apcp.assembly.ca.gov), which lists SB 243 as Chapter 677, Statutes of 2025. The text on leginfo was not stored. The reporting start of 1 Jul 2027 and the 2026-09-10 last-updated date are not confirmed by any stored text.
